entries.german: desgl. auf Klage des Hrz. Heinrich v. Baiern über Thomas v. Rosenberg u. Wilhelm v. Tottenheim [vgl. die Aberachtserkl. 1422 Sept. 10.]
entries.english: Likewise, following a complaint by Duke Heinrich of Bavaria against Thomas von Rosenberg and Wilhelm von Dottenheim [see the declaration of the imperial ban, 10 September 1422].
